notes: Draft configuration: Outer race loop with direct long straight and northern linked bends; excludes the parallel infield return. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3247.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: The original border pair skips the retained source route bend near the southern pit entrance and its outer border has a spur across the straight. Independent sparse image observations follow the retained route and selected road limits, excluding runoff; unobserved intervals remain estimated.

measurement.note: NCM Corvette loop: 213 sparse edge observations and two repeated closure anchors independently located on raw pinned licensed-image cross-sections at roughly 30 m spacing. Offsets read to 0.5 m; this is not surveyed accuracy. Selected limits follow visible paint, the asphalt side of curbs, asphalt transitions and grass, excluding adjoining runoff and pit access. No anchor is claimed at negative-normal station 130 (shadow) or positive-normal stations 210, 240, 360 and 670 (junction openings); these gaps and all unmeasured intervals interpolate. Texture transitions, paint and image resolution add uncertainty. Source layout identity remains draft. No automatic proposal coordinates were used.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
